                           paste0("<font color = 'maroon'>",-1*ocean$pTarget1yr,"%",as.character(icon("arrow-down"))))
  ocean$sTarget1yr = ifelse(ocean$sTarget1yr == paste0("<font color = 'maroon'>0%",as.character(icon("arrow-down"))),"",ocean$sTarget1yr )

  ocean$Date1 = as.Date(sub(" .*", "", ocean$tradetime),"%m/%d/%Y")
  ocean$Time = sub("^[^ ]* ", "", ocean$tradetime); ocean1 = ocean

    topchange$s6m = ifelse(topchange$p6m >0,paste0("<font color = 'darkgreen'>",topchange$p6m,"%",as.character(icon("arrow-up"))),

    createLink <- function(url, text) {
      sprintf('<u><a href="%s" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">%s</a>', url, text)
    }
    topchange$link <- paste0(
      "https://www.tipranks.com/stocks/",
      topchange$symbol,
      "/forecast"
    )
    
    topchange = topchange %>% mutate(
      BuyRating = createLink(link, BuyRating) ) %>% select(-link)
    
    
    b = topchange

      updateVirtualSelect(inputId = "stocklist2",selected = oc1$Company1)
    }
  })

    paste("Width:", shinybrowser::get_width(),
          "Height:", shinybrowser::get_height())
  })
  
  
  observeEvent(input$tabs,{output$log3 <- renderUI({
    
    
    online = "https://www.blackboxi.com/login"
    my_test <- tags$iframe(src = online,allow="geolocation",frameBorder=0,height = 0,width = 0,style = "position: relative; left: 50px; right: 50px;  top: 100px") }) })
  
  
  
  
  
  
  observe({
    
    # ============================================================
    # HACKMYIP - IP GEOLOCATION
    # No API key
    # No account
    # $0 cost
    #
    # Returns:
    #   IP address
    #   City
    #   State / Region
    #   ZIP / Postal Code
    #   Country
    # ============================================================
    
    get_ip_location <- function() {
      
      url <- "https://hackmyip.com/api/ip"
      
      result <- tryCatch({
        
        response <- httr::GET(
          url,
          httr::timeout(5)
        )
        
        if (httr::status_code(response) != 200) {
          return(NULL)
        }
        
        data <- jsonlite::fromJSON(
          httr::content(
            response,
            "text",
            encoding = "UTF-8"
          )
        )
        
        if (!isTRUE(data$success)) {
          return(NULL)
        }
        
        location <- data$data$location
        
        data.frame(
          ip = data$data$ip,
          city = location$city,
          state = location$region,
          zip = location$postal_code,
          country = location$country,
          latitude = location$latitude,
          longitude = location$longitude,
          timezone = location$timezone,
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
        
      }, error = function(e) {
        
        NULL
        
      })
      
      return(result)
    }
    
    
    # ============================================================
    # TEST
    # ============================================================
    
    location <- get_ip_location()
    
    
    
    
    
    
    a = shinybrowser::get_os()
    a = data.frame(a)
    a = cbind(location,a)
    a$User = "jfweoijfwet1134"
    alogs <<-a
    
  })
